description: This file defines React components and hooks for fetching and managing workspace optimization dashboard data in the Mattermost admin console, including various checks and data retrieval functions.

methods.name: getUpdatesData
methods.description: Fetches data related to server updates, including checks for available updates.

methods.name: getAccessData
methods.description: Fetches workspace access configuration and issues.

methods.name: getPerformanceData
methods.description: Fetches server performance-related data and issues.

methods.name: getDataPrivacyData
methods.description: Fetches data privacy and compliance-related data.

methods.name: getEaseOfManagementData
methods.description: Fetches ease of management related data.

methods.name: useMetricsData
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages fetching and state for all workspace optimization dashboard data.
